items.name: Head and Shoulders Top
items.structure_definition: Three swing highs; middle high is the head; two lower shoulders; neckline joins the intervening swing lows.
items.deterministic_detection_outline: Find 5 alternating pivots H-L-H-L-H with central high above both shoulders; shoulders within configurable tolerance; fit neckline through the two lows.
items.confirmation_rule: Close below neckline, preferably with expanding relative volume; optional neckline retest rejection.
items.invalidation_rule: Close above right shoulder / invalidate structure if price makes a new high above head.
items.target_model: Head-to-neckline height projected down from neckline break.
items.parameter_warning: Defaults are starting search values, not universal truths. Calibrate only on training data and preserve a separate out-of-sample set.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: A pivot is usable only after its right-side confirmation bars have closed. Do not backdate signals to the pivot bar.

items.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
items.structure_definition: Three swing lows; central low is the head; two higher shoulders; neckline joins intervening highs.
items.deterministic_detection_outline: Find 5 alternating pivots L-H-L-H-L with central low below both shoulders; shoulders within tolerance; fit neckline through highs.
items.confirmation_rule: Close above neckline; optional retest hold.
items.invalidation_rule: Close below head / invalidate if price breaks below head low.
items.target_model: Neckline minus head projected upward from breakout.
items.parameter_warning: Defaults are starting search values, not universal truths. Calibrate only on training data and preserve a separate out-of-sample set.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: A pivot is usable only after its right-side confirmation bars have closed. Do not backdate signals to the pivot bar.

items.confirmation_rule: Close below trough / neckline; use volume expansion as a filter, not a hard requirement.
items.invalidation_rule: Close above both highs by a volatility buffer.
items.target_model: Pattern height (top to trough) projected below neckline.

items.structure_definition: Range after advance with buying climax, automatic reaction, secondary test, upthrust/UTAD, sign of weakness and last point of supply.
items.deterministic_detection_outline: Detect event sequence within range; volume/spread context; store confidence per event.
items.confirmation_rule: Sign of Weakness below range and failed Last Point of Supply.

items.name: Wyckoff Spring
items.structure_definition: False breakdown below established trading-range support followed by rapid reclaim.
items.deterministic_detection_outline: Require prior range, low below support by limited buffer, then close back within range within N bars.
items.confirmation_rule: Reclaim plus test / higher low.
items.target_model: Range top / range midpoint.

items.name: Wyckoff Upthrust / UTAD
items.structure_definition: False breakout above established range resistance followed by failure back into range.
items.deterministic_detection_outline: Require prior range, high above resistance, then close back inside within N bars; UTAD is late-stage distribution context.
items.confirmation_rule: Failure/rejection and break of minor support.
items.target_model: Range midpoint / range floor.

items.name: Breakout and Retest
items.structure_definition: Close beyond a pre-defined support/resistance zone followed by a controlled retest that holds.
items.deterministic_detection_outline: Define zones from pivots/volume profile; breakout buffer in ATR; retest window and tolerance explicit.
items.confirmation_rule: Rejection away from broken level after retest.
items.invalidation_rule: Close back through level by buffer.
items.target_model: Next major structure or measured range.

items.name: False Breakout / Failed Auction

items.deterministic_detection_outline: Detect breach of support/resistance and same-bar or N-bar close back inside; distinguish stop-run wick vs sustained break.
items.confirmation_rule: Opposite-side confirmation / break of failure candle.
items.target_model: Range midpoint/opposite boundary.

items.name: Inside Bar / Mother-Bar Compression
items.structure_definition: Current high and low are contained within prior mother bar range.
items.deterministic_detection_outline: High[t] < High[t-1] and Low[t] > Low[t-1], configurable strict/inclusive inequalities.
items.confirmation_rule: Break of mother-bar high/low; direction only after break.
items.invalidation_rule: Opposite side of mother bar or setup candle.
items.target_model: Mother-bar range or ATR multiple.

items.name: Outside Bar / Engulfing Range Bar
items.structure_definition: Current bar makes a higher high and lower low than prior bar.
items.deterministic_detection_outline: High[t] > High[t-1] and Low[t] < Low[t-1]; classify body close location and trend context separately.
items.confirmation_rule: Close near extreme / break of outside bar in directional bias.

items.name: Pin Bar / Rejection Bar
items.structure_definition: Small real body near one end of range with a prominent opposing rejection wick.
items.deterministic_detection_outline: Wick/body and wick/range ratios; body-location threshold; require nearby level and trend context.
items.confirmation_rule: Break of pin-bar extreme in rejection direction or next-bar confirmation.
